description: A code-findings item for an agent: a regression (a finding verified fixed that a scan reports again) or a location gap (a result with no repository path or no stable locator, so it is no finding yet).

finding.description: A regression's finding Subject id: get security.finding/<finding>.

kind.description: regression (a finding verified fixed that a scan reports again) or location_gap (a result the scan could not place).

locus.description: A regression's locus (path#locator): the finding key's locus.

path.description: The repository-relative path the result names, or (none).

reason.description: Why a location gap is no finding (for example no_repository_path or no_stable_location).

ref.description: The item's identity: the kind, then the finding and scan revision, or the rule and path.

repo.description: The repository (host/owner/repo): the finding key's repo.

rule.description: The rule that reported it, as tool:ruleId.

weakness.description: A regression's weakness (CWE-n or RULE:tool/ruleId): the finding key's weakness.

name: security.sarif-attention
